data.title: 2H 2019 Transparency Report Statistics
data.content:
The total number of government requests for communication data on our services amounts to 199, an approximately 93.7% decrease compared to the second half of 2018. Kakao has not provided communication data since the first half of 2013.
If any data for communication-restricting measures is requested for Daum services, a certain part of data is provided after a thorough review based on legal standards, while we do not provide any data on the above measures in the case of Kakao services.
The number of requests for communication data related to Daum services has slightly increased compared to the second half of 2018, while the number of cases processed has decreased. In case of Kakao services, the number of such cases has both declined.
The number of requests for Daum services based on a warrant of seizure and search has decreased compared to the second half of 2018. Meanwhile, the number of requests for Kakao services has increased compared to the second half of 2018, due to an increase in intensive controls by investigation agencies. In the second half of 2019, there was an intensive crackdown on crimes like cyber gambling and infringement of public welfare. Due to an increase in the number of warrants of seizure from investigation agencies for specific investigations, the number of accounts and cases processed has inevitably increased. However, Kakao has provided only the minimum information that meets the requirements.
